   110	## 5. Initialisation Sequence
   111	
   112	```
   113	[Precondition: External 12V Aux Power available]
   114	  → low-voltage-power-supply initialises (produces 12V, 5V, 3.3V, 1.2V rails)
   115	      → microcontroller-module boots (consumes logic rails)
   116	          → microcontroller-module sends Wake-up Command to communication-bridge
   117	              → communication-bridge translates Wake-up ping to Daisy Chain
   118	                  → bms-monitor-module(s) wake up sequentially
   119	                      → microcontroller-module performs auto-addressing and node validation
   120	                          → current-sensing performs Zero-Point Calibration
   121	                              → [System ready state]
   122	```

   131	| LV to HV (Sense) | CS / MCU | SiO2 Barrier (AMC1301) | 1000V DC | Isolated Analog Current |
   132	| LV to HV (Power) | LVPS (Pri/Sec) | Isolated Flyback | 1000V DC | Logic Power Rails |
   133	| HV to LV (Logic) | HVPS / CS | Non-Isolated Buck | 700V (MOSFET) | Hot-side Bias (VDD1) |
